messages.subject: How to orient clade labels in circular plot?
messages.subject_clean: How to orient clade labels in circular plot?
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm trying to annotate clades of a circular plot.  I would like to find a way to automatically orient the labels to be parallel (tangent) to the circle.  As it stands, it seems like I'll have to manually tweak each clade label's angle depending on where it happens to fall along the circle.  Any ideas of how to make a parallel/tangent orientation work?

Thanks.
Allie

nwk <- system.file("extdata", "sample.nwk", package="treeio")
 <https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#cb188-2>
 <https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#cb188-3>tree <- read.tree(nwk)
 <https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#cb188-4>circ <- ggtree(tree, layout = "circular")
 <https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#cb188-5>
circ + geom_cladelabel(19, "taxa1") + geom_cladelabel(21, "taxa2")

messages.subject_clean: colour for cells with NA value on gheatmap
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm making gheatmap with continuous values except some of the values are NA.

When I set the two colours for low and high, the cells with NA are white as I wish.

But when I use a colour scale as below since I want more colours on heatmap, the NA cells are coloured as grey.

If I colour all the cells as white with scale_fill_gradientn(colours = "white"), those NA cells are still grey.

I've tried to change the panel and plot background but it doesn't change.

So, how can I leave NA cells as white if I want to use a colour scale?
